_readme: All team-written narrative lives here. Every value that starts with TODO-TEAM is a slot for you to write: replace the whole string, keep the key. Do not contradict the PDFs (content/canon.json). One slot per line so the slot list can point at exact line numbers.

intake.heading: TODO-TEAM: heading on the agent intake form (the first screen a visitor sees)
intake.briefingFrom: TODO-TEAM: who signs the briefing memo (name and title)
intake.briefing1: TODO-TEAM: briefing paragraph 1, who is addressing the new agent and why they were recruited
intake.briefing2: TODO-TEAM: briefing paragraph 2, what the agent is about to investigate (stay within the Case Debrief)
intake.briefing3: TODO-TEAM: briefing paragraph 3, what is expected of the agent before they open the case files
intake.oath: TODO-TEAM: the line the agent must agree to before entering (e.g. a confidentiality undertaking)
intake.welcome: TODO-TEAM: one line shown after the codename is accepted; use {codename} where the name should appear

files.intro: TODO-TEAM: short note at the top of the case files telling the agent what to look for
files.outro: TODO-TEAM: note shown once every key detail is pinned and the folder is sent to forensics

forensics.intro: TODO-TEAM: short note introducing the energy records
forensics.outro: TODO-TEAM: reply from the Department of Electricity after the referral form is accepted

signal.intro: TODO-TEAM: short note introducing the Machine ID as something that needs decoding
signal.outro: TODO-TEAM: line shown when the decoded key opens the machine

machine.intro: TODO-TEAM: what the agent sees as the cabinet powers up (one or two lines)
machine.twist1: TODO-TEAM: terminal log line that starts revealing POI-1 came out of the game
machine.twist2: TODO-TEAM: terminal log line that ties the 23 October power surge to the crossing
machine.twist3: TODO-TEAM: terminal log line that confirms the crossing
machine.case2Hook: TODO-TEAM: the closing line that sets up Case #2

report.closing: TODO-TEAM: closing statement printed at the bottom of the case report
